sections.html: Hypselobarbus jerdoni is a very rarely imported large barb. It reaches a maximum final length of 50 cm and is only suitable for really large aquariums.
It is an endemic species of southern India, where it is found in the states of Karnataka and Kerala.

This current-loving, peaceful fish is a real eye-catcher. In nature, the animal performs spawning migrations of up to 100 km in length. From this it can be concluded that it is a powerful swimmer, capable of overcoming obstacles. When caught in the aquarium, it can jump vertically over 50 cm out of the water from a standing position, even when only 6-8 cm long. Nevertheless the species is anything but shy.
The brilliant orange pelvic fins are its unique selling point, something not found in any other barb species.
